dev.description: Run desktop app serving built frontend/dist

tasks.package:linux: deno task build:frontend && mkdir -p dist/linux && rm -rf dist/linux/excalidraw-offline && deno desktop -A --backend=webview --compress=xz --include=./frontend/dist --include=./icons --include=./skills --output=./dist/linux/excalidraw-offline ./desktop/main.ts
tasks.package:appimage: deno task build:frontend && mkdir -p dist/linux && rm -f dist/linux/excalidraw-offline.AppImage && deno desktop -A --backend=webview --compress=xz --include=./frontend/dist --include=./icons --include=./skills --output=./dist/linux/excalidraw-offline.AppImage ./desktop/main.ts
tasks.test:file-format: deno test -A desktop/file-format_test.ts desktop/path_test.ts desktop/dialogs_test.ts desktop/dialogs-win_test.ts desktop/close-guard_test.ts desktop/recent-files_test.ts desktop/versions_test.ts desktop/install-skill_test.ts desktop/cli-args_test.ts desktop/instance-registry_test.ts desktop/open-path_test.ts desktop/platform_test.ts desktop/file-association-win_test.ts
tasks.package:windows: deno task build:frontend && deno desktop -A --backend=webview --compress=xz --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --include=./frontend/dist --include=./icons --include=./skills --output=./dist/windows/excalidraw-offline ./desktop/main.ts
